Game Overview

In Tori, the core idea is straightforward: join Tori on a thrilling 2D platform escapade. Conquer eight intricate levels by collecting all orange balls while dodging fearsome foes and traps. Master double-jumping with precise timing to overcome challenges and aim for the victory flag. Dive in for skillful trials packed with escalating excitement.
